thread:
rachel: FYI i started a tiny PR to add SEA/SG availability notes and a Ruby SDK example + CLI migration checklist: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/2499. need copy + runtime confirmation for wording around 'region availability' vs 'residency'.

priya: love it. can we show Ruby and a simple CLI example? we usually prefer env var pattern (REDWOOD_REGION). also add a short line about fallbacks impacting latency.

rachel: added Ruby snippet: 
```ruby
# ruby example
ENV['REDWOOD_REGION'] = 'apac-sg-1'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], region: ENV['REDWOOD_REGION'])
resp = client.generate(prompt: 'hello')
```
and a CLI migration note: 
```bash
# new regional domain
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.apac-sg-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# legacy header fallback
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: apac-sg-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

legal-ops: quick copy check 12: avoid absolutes like "data never leaves region". suggested phrasing: "Where available, Hosted processing and storage occur in the selected region. For Dedicated and Private deployments, contractual residency controls can be specified in your agreement (see DPA: https://redwood.example.com/dpa). Some operational metadata (telemetry, backups) may be processed outside the selected region; see the DPA for details."

rachel: updated PR with that exact language and added a footnote about cached logs not being replicated cross-region by default.

eng-runtime: confirm KV/local cache behavior: cache is cluster-local. For Dedicated/Private it's region-local unless cross-region replication is enabled. For Hosted we attempt regional routing but may read from another region during failover; added that sentence to the doc. Also confirming regional domains are supported for embeddings endpoints as well.

priya: tiny nit: add an explicit sentence telling customers to update SDK minor versions to pick up region param behavior. added a short migration checklist in PR.

docs-bot: Docs CI: ✅ 3/3 checks passed (lint, links, preview). Preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/pr-2499

rachel: excellent, pushed the remaining tweaks and merged after CI. leaving this thread here for the changelog note in the release docs. thanks all! :shipit:
